_schema.note: Antagonist tiering for the game. 'implemented' marks bosses present in the vertical slice; phase designs are GAME MECHANICS derived from the cited events.

canon_basis: Cindercrest ground assault on Fort Feather
Persuading the Royal Army to defect
Crowning himself King and killing new players

phases.name: Cindercrest Vanguard
phases.basis: The ground assault that Fort Feather initially repelled.
phases.mechanic: Dense netherite waves with Cindercrest Warriors; Saparata is not yet on the field.

phases.name: Elite Strike — ShoeBilly
phases.basis: ShoeBilly's assassinations and mace fighting at Merchant City / Steampunk City.
phases.mechanic: Mini-boss ShoeBilly disables towers he passes; his helmet breaks at 50% (armor tier drops).

phases.name: The Redstone Blimp
phases.mechanic: A blimp crosses the fort dropping paratroopers along the path; shooting it down ends the drops early.

phases.name: Saparata Enters
phases.mechanic: Saparata walks the path in enchanted netherite with a mace; Ember Strike stuns the nearest tower; Revanchist Call heals him when Cindercrest soldiers die nearby; he challenges the hero to a duel when in range.

phases.name: The Usurper King
phases.basis: Persuading the Royal Army to defect; crowning himself King.
phases.mechanic: Below 50% HP he dons the crown: Persuasion turns one tower against you for a few seconds, Royal Defectors join the waves, and below 25% he gains speed and damage resistance (Old Players' Wrath).

canon_basis: Mace duel with Wemmbu; helmet broken by stab shots

phases.name: Web of the Caves
phases.mechanic: Web traps on build zones (design only).
